query: select n.nspname as schema_name, c.relname as table_name, case when a.grantee=0 then 'PUBLIC' else pg_catalog.pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text end as grantee, a.privilege_type, a.is_grantable from pg_catalog.pg_class c join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace cross join lateral pg_catalog.aclexplode(coalesce(c.relacl,pg_catalog.acldefault('r',c.relowner))) a where n.nspname in ('public','private') and c.relkind in ('r','p') order by 1,2,3,4;
